ability.name: Revive
ability.description:
Revive target dead ally.

Can be used in combat

ability.name: Chickenize!
ability.description:
Instantly turn your target into a chicken.

Chickenize! can only be used a limited amount of times per dungeon. The charges are shared by everyone in the party.

Chickenized enemies do not give Kill Score.

Can be used during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Al'zerac's Shackle
ability.description:
Instantly Freeze target enemy in a block of ice for 3 seconds, incapacitating them for the duration. While frozen, the target takes 1,566 - 1,914 frost damage every 1.5 seconds for the duration.

Upon Expiration, the target erupts in an explosion of frost magic, instantly dealing 567 - 693 frost damage to all enemies in an 800 radius and Chilling them, reducing their Movement Speed by 65% and their Attack Speed by 40% for 12 seconds.

While Chilled, the afflicted enemies take 226 - 277 frost damage every 2 seconds for the duration.

Can be cast during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Major Dispel
ability.description:
Instantly Dispel all harmful magic effects from you and your allies in a large radius around you.

Can be used during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Fated Strike
ability.description:
Strike target enemy, dealing 6,651 - 8,129 damage to it and cleaving for 2,586 - 3,161 damage to nearby enemies.

Fated Strike applies Glorious Purpose to you for 6 seconds, granting you +200% increased Cooldown Acceleration for the duration.

If used at range, Fated Strike will cause you to charge to your target.

ability.name: Fated Strike
ability.description:
Strike target enemy, dealing 6,651 - 8,129 damage to it and cleaving for 2,586 - 3,161 damage to nearby enemies.

Fated Strike applies Glorious Purpose to you for 6 seconds, granting you +200% increased Cooldown Acceleration for the duration.

If used at range, Fated Strike will cause you to charge to your target.

ability.name: Sahril's Wrath
ability.description:
Instantly deal 18,981 - 23,199 fire damage to all enemies within a 1000 radius.

You gain 1 stack of Sundering Wrath for each enemy hit up to a maximum of 5 stacks, grating you +6% additional critical strike chance per stack for 20 seconds.

Can be cast during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Major Invisibility
ability.description:
Instantly conceal yourself all nearby allies, granting Major Invisiblilty for 15 seconds.

Can only be used out of combat.

ability.name: Rejuvenate
ability.description:
Instantly replenish 40% of your maximum health.

Can be used during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Interject Spell
ability.description:
Interrupt the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec.
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

Can be used during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Restore Mana
ability.description:
Instantly restore 30% of your maximum mana.

Can be used during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Bloodrite Fervor
ability.description:
You and nearby allies gain 50% increased Movement Speed for 12 seconds.

Can be used during Global Cooldown

trait.name: Bleeding Hearts
trait.description:
Your Heart Splitter ability has 2 Charges and a 25% chance to strike the target 1 additional time.

Heart Splitter has +100% Critical Strike chance when striking targets above 80% health.

trait.name: Bloody Mess
trait.description: Your Grim Carve spins 2 additional times.

trait.name: Carrion Onslaught
trait.description:
Your Owed in Blood ability grants you Carrion Onslaught, increasing the damage of your next Blood Arc by 20%. The damage bonus is further increased by 2% for each stack of Owed in Blood that was consumed.

Carrion Onslaught also causes your next Blood Arc to instantly spawn up to 10 Blood Feathers, and then up to 10 again every 2 seconds over 8 seconds.

The total number of Blood Feathers spawned is relative to the number of Owed in Blood stacks that were consumed.

ability.name: Conjure Portal
ability.description:
Conjures two interactable Portals that you and your allies can use to safely travel between two points.

Can only have 1 active portal at a time.

ability.name: Earthbreaker
ability.description:
Conjure the Earthbreaker into your hands and instantly slam it into the ground, causing the ground to erupt with natural magic in a cone in front of you, dealing 7,890 - 9,643 nature damage to all enemies in it and Stunning them for 3 seconds.

The area continues to rupture for 10 seconds, dealing 1,198 - 1,465 every 1.5 seconds to enemies in standing in it.

After 10 seconds, the area erupts a 2nd time, dealing 11,394 - 13,926 to all enemies in it and stunning them for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Sahril's Aegis
ability.description:
You are protected by the divine flame of Sahril, granting you a shield for up to 18 seconds that absorbs up to 10,500 damage.

Any damage the shield absorbs is reduced by 50%.

When the shield expires it explodes on to enemies within a 1000 radius, dealing 20,169 - 24,651 fire damage to them.

Can be cast during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Voidbringer's Touch
ability.description:
Apply Voidbringer's Touch to target enemy for 15 seconds, causing 10% of all damage you deal to any enemy to be replicated and stored in the effect.

Once Voidbringer's Touch expires, or a total of 42,500 damage has been accumulated, the effect erupts in a shadowy explosion, instantly dealing the accumulated damage to the target.

Voidbringer's Touch has +100% critical strike chance.

Voidbringer's Touch always triggers if the damage it holds is greater than the remaining health of the enemy it is applied to.

Can be cast during Global Cooldown

ability.name: Zeraleth's Hunger
ability.description:
Deal 5,463 - 6,677 magic damage every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds to target enemy while channeling. You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt.

Any amount of overhealing on you from Zarelth's Hunger is projected to up to 3 allies within 3000 radius of you, healing those players for the overhealing amount, evenly divided.
